system: neutral nickelocene (NiCp2, Ni(C5H5)2) adsorbed on a nine-Br island on Au(111)

molecule.connectivity: Ni bonded symmetrically to the centroids of two eta5-cyclopentadienyl rings; each ring is C5H5 with aromatic five-member connectivity
molecule.stereochemistry: none specified; eta5 rings may rotate
molecule.atom_labels: Ni, C1-C5/H1-H5 for lower Cp and C6-C10/H6-H10 for upper Cp

surface.slab: Periodic Au(111) adsorption slab with the specified in-plane metric; vacuum >10 Angstrom; bottom two Au layers fixed. The paper's additional 4x4 Au unit cell belongs to the Br-tip junction model, not this adsorption substrate. Total adsorption-slab layer count is not specified in the methods paragraph and must not be inferred from that tip model.
surface.br_island: 9 Br atoms in quasi-(sqrt(3) x sqrt(3))R30 degree arrangement on the Au(111) surface

target_state.site: conf3: NiCp2 centered over the bridge between two adjacent Br atoms in the nine-atom island
target_state.initialization: place molecule above the selected Br-Br bridge with molecular axis tilted 5-15 degrees from the surface plane; document height, azimuth and selected pair
target_state.spin: spin-polarized; preserve the sign convention and report magnitude

public_boundary: Do not use or report any paper target value, expected interval or winning geometry as an input.
